text:
Elena Park: Quick heads-up: Hosted Toolcall Insights is GA today. New features: per-tool success/failure breakdowns, sampled payload traces, and a Console -> Toolcalls -> Insights view. Rolling out regionally over the next 90 minutes. :sparkles:
Ravi Menon: nice! any breaking changes for SDKs or clients?
Elena Park: no breaking changes. Optional opt-in header for richer traces: `X-Redwood-Toolcall-Insight: full`. SDKs will expose an opt-in flag for convenience.
Sophie Liu: monitoring concern 1 will this spike telemetry volume?
eng-sre-bot: added runbook and alerts. Watch for +25% p95 tool-latency or +7% error-rate sustained >10m: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/toolcall-insights
Elena Park: sampling is asynchronous; normal requests unaffected. Basic metrics are free. Exporting full sampled traces is an opt-in billed export (labelled "insights-exports") 1 see docs for pricing examples.
docs-bot: docs are live: https://docs.redwood.ai/toolcall-insights (includes curl and js SDK examples)
Ravi Menon: Dedicated/private customers?
Elena Park: Dedicated: admin toggle in Console -> Admin -> Feature Flags -> ToolcallInsights. Private: included in 1.8.2 patch; operators must enable the insights service and migration script is in the repo.
Sophie Liu: canary keys and rollback plan?
eng-sre-bot: canaries: insights-canary-01..04. Auto-rollback if error-rate +5% for 10m or malformed trace ratio >2%. Manual rollback instructions in runbook.
Ravi Menon: marketing/comms?
Elena Park: Product will send customer email and a changelog entry. We'll deprecate the old `legacy-tool-telemetry` toggle on 2026-09-01; migration guide in docs.
Sophie Liu: pasteable curl sample?
Elena Park: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Toolcall-Insight: full" \
  -d '{"tool":"search","input":"recent orders"}'
```
Ravi Menon: Q&A at 17:30 PT in #product. Please tag @eng-sre for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
